Math. 2020] proved the existence of hyperbolic motions with any positive energy constant, starting from any configuration and along any non-collision configuration.

arxiv-2205-10637.title: Symmetry Teleportation for Accelerated Optimization
arxiv-2205-10637.creator: Bo Zhao, Nima Dehmamy, Robin Walters, Rose Yu
arxiv-2205-10637.description: Abstract Existing gradient-based optimization methods update parameters locally, in a direction that minimizes the loss function. We study a different approach, symmetry teleportation, that allows parameters to travel a large distance on the loss level set, in order to improve the convergence speed in subsequent steps. Teleportation exploits symmetries in the loss landscape of optimization problems.

arxiv-2208-12843.title: A Breakdown Free Numerical Algorithm for Inverting General Tridiagonal Matrices Journal: Journal of L a T e X Templates
arxiv-2208-12843.creator: Moawwad El-Mikkawy, Abdelrahman Karawia
arxiv-2208-12843.description: Abstract In the current paper the authors linked two methods in order to evaluate general n-th order tridiagonal determinants. A breakdown free numerical algorithm is developed for computing the inverse of any n × n n\times n general nonsingular tridiagonal matrix without imposing any constrains.

arxiv-2305-03179.title: Qumode transfer between continuous and discrete variable devices
arxiv-2305-03179.creator: Alexandru Macridin, Andy C. Y. Li, Panagiotis Spentzouris
arxiv-2305-03179.description: Abstract Transferring quantum information between different types of quantum hardware is crucial for integrated quantum technology. In particular, converting information between continuous-variable (CV) and discrete-variable (DV) devices enables many applications in quantum networking, quantum sensing, quantum machine learning, and quantum computing. This paper addresses the transfer of CV-encoded information between CV and DV devices.

arxiv-2312-09999.title: On graphs without cycles of length 0 0 modulo 4 4

arxiv-2312-09999.description: Abstract Bollobás proved that for every k k and ℓ \ell such that k ​ ℤ + ℓ k\mathbb{Z}+\ell contains an even number, an n n -vertex graph containing no cycle of length ℓ mod k \ell\bmod k can contain at most a linear number of edges.

arxiv-2406-13336.title: Berezinsky Hidden Sources: An Emergent Tension in the High-Energy Neutrino Sky?
arxiv-2406-13336.creator: Antonio Ambrosone
arxiv-2406-13336.description: Abstract The IceCube Collaboration has recently reported compelling evidence of high-energy neutrino emission from NGC 1068, and also mild excesses for NGC 4151 and CGCG420-015, local Seyfert galaxies. This has increased the interest along neutrino emission from hot-corona surrounding the super massive black holes of Seyfert Galaxies.

arxiv-2407-06410.title: Rotational Properties of Inverted Hybrid Stars
arxiv-2407-06410.creator: Rodrigo Negreiros, Chen Zhang, Renxin Xu
arxiv-2407-06410.description: Abstract We study the rotational properties of inverted hybrid stars (IHSs), which have been recently proposed as a possible new class of compact stars characterized by an outer layer of quark matter and a core of hadronic matter, in an inverted structure compared to traditional hybrid stars. We analyze distinct models representing varying depths of quark-hadron phase transitions.

arxiv-2502-02274.title: Hyperpolygonal arrangements
arxiv-2502-02274.creator: Lorenzo Giordani, Paul Mücksch, Gerhard Röhrle, Johannes Schmitt
arxiv-2502-02274.description: Abstract . In [ BCS+24 ] , a particular family of real hyperplane arrangements stemming from hyperpolygonal spaces associated with certain quiver varieties was introduced which we thus call hyperpolygonal arrangements ℋ n {\mathscr{H}}_{n} . In this note we study these arrangements and investigate their properties systematically.

arxiv-2503-18751.title: Construction Identification and Disambiguation Using BERT: A Case Study of NPN
arxiv-2503-18751.creator: Wesley Scivetti, Nathan Schneider
arxiv-2503-18751.description: Abstract Construction Grammar hypothesizes that knowledge of a language consists chiefly of knowledge of form–meaning pairs (“constructions”) that include vocabulary, general grammar rules, and even idiosyncratic patterns. Recent work has shown that transformer language models represent at least some constructional patterns, including ones where the construction is rare overall.

arxiv-2505-01359.title: Dual system estimation using mixed effects loglinear models
arxiv-2505-01359.creator: Ceejay Hammond, Paul A. Smith, Peter G.M. van der Heijden
arxiv-2505-01359.description: Abstract In official statistics, dual system estimation (DSE) is a well-known tool to estimate the size of a population. Two sources are linked, and the number of units that are missed by both sources is estimated. Often dual system estimation is carried out in each of the levels of a stratifying variable, such as region.

pmc-10704649.title: Assessing the content validity of the Manchester–Oxford Foot Questionnaire in surgically treated ankle fracture patients: a qualitative study
pmc-10704649.creator: Michael Q. Nguyen, Anders Broström, Marjolein M. Iversen, Knut Harboe, Aksel Paulsen
pmc-10704649.description: BackgroundRoughly 10% of fractures in adults are ankle fractures. These injuries are found in both sexes and present with different fracture characteristics. The treatment varies with the patients’ biology and fracture type, and the goals are to restore stability, prevent pain and maintain ankle function. Clinicians generally use outcomes like assessment of radiography, pain level, or function.

pmc-10742777.title: Machine Learning Radiomics Signature for Differentiating Lymphoma versus Benign Splenomegaly on CT
pmc-10742777.creator: Jih-An Cheng, Yu-Chun Lin, Yenpo Lin, Ren-Chin Wu, Hsin-Ying Lu, Lan-Yan Yang, Hsin-Ju Chiang, Yu-Hsiang Juan, Ying-Chieh Lai, Gigin Lin
pmc-10742777.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Background: We aimed to develop and validate a preoperative CT-based radiomics signature for differentiating lymphoma versus benign splenomegaly. Methods: We retrospectively analyzed CT studies from 139 patients (age range 26–93 years, 43% female) between 2011 and 2019 with histopathological diagnosis of the spleen (19 lymphoma, 120 benign) and divided them into developing (n = 79) and testing (n = 60) datasets. The volumetric radiomic features were extracted from manual segmentation of the whole spleen on venous-phase CT imaging using PyRadiomics package.

pmc-11504376.title: Investigation and control of an outbreak of methicillin-susceptible Staphylococcus aureus skin and soft tissue infections in a level IV NICU
pmc-11504376.creator: Gisel Rivera, Kara Mitchell, Jamie Marino, Vivien Yap, Liana Senaldi, Priyanka Tiwari, Jean-Marie Cannon, Rebecca Marrero Roldon, Marie-Claire Rowlinson, Wolfgang Haas, Rae-Jean Hemway, David Calfee, Lisa Saiman, Lars Westblade, Karen Acker
pmc-11504376.description: Background: Neonatal intensive care units (NICU) outbreaks caused by methicillin-susceptible Staphylococcus aureus (MSSA) are less commonly reported than outbreaks caused by methicillin-resistant S. aureus. We report an unusual outbreak of MSSA skin and soft tissue infections (SSTIs) in a level IV NICU investigated by whole genome sequencing (WGS) and molecular typing.

pmc-12489403.title: Psychotherapists’ Ethical Dilemmas Regarding Online and Face-to-Face Psychotherapy During the COVID-19 Pandemic: Survey Study
pmc-12489403.creator: Emilia Rutkowska, Joanna Furmańska, Cristiana C Marques, Maria João Martins, Håkan Lane, Johannes Meixner
pmc-12489403.description: BackgroundDuring the COVID-19 pandemic, mental health professionals were forced to find an appropriate way of working with patients that would ensure the continuity of therapy while considering the restrictions aimed at counteracting the spread of the virus. Online therapy has become an increasingly popular and common form of psychotherapeutic work.

pmc-12585927.title: Isolated Unilateral Pleural Effusion Associated With Hypothyroidism: A Case Report and Review of the Literature
pmc-12585927.creator: Hesam Amini, Fereshteh Attaran, Sara Soltanmohammadi
pmc-12585927.description: A 77‐year‐old man with COPD and hypertension presented with progressive exertional dyspnea over 3 months. Physical examination revealed decreased breath sounds in the right lung base and signs suggestive of hypothyroidism, including dry skin and lateral eyebrow thinning. CT imaging showed emphysematous changes with moderate right pleural effusion. Pleural fluid analysis consistently showed borderline transudate/exudate characteristics.

pmc-12588713.title: Rapid Initiation of Hyperbaric Oxygen Therapy for Multiple Simultaneous Cases of Acute Carbon Monoxide Poisoning at a Single Center
pmc-12588713.creator: Takayuki Kurokawa, Ichiyo Ohara, Chie Watanabe, Koji Kuwata, Itsumi Hashimoto, Manabu Kitagaki, Takehiko Murakami
pmc-12588713.description: IntroductionHyperbaric oxygen therapy (HBOT) is used to treat acute carbon monoxide poisoning. However, few reports have detailed its use in large patient cohorts, and optimal management guidelines have yet to be established. Herein, we report the clinical presentation and simultaneous treatment of multiple patients experiencing acute carbon monoxide poisoning on an offshore ship within the territorial waters of Japan.

pmc-12827124.title: Biomarker role in assessing imaging needs for mild cranial trauma (BRAIN-CT): study protocol for a single-center, randomized controlled trial
pmc-12827124.creator: Ali Tfaily, Ariana Chacon, Tianwen Ma, Jonathan Ratcliff, Randi Smith, Hassan Saad, Andrew Reisner, David Gimbel, Kevin Wang, Firas Kobeissy, Jonathan A. Grossberg, Ali M. Alawieh
pmc-12827124.description: IntroductionMild traumatic brain injury (mTBI) accounts for a significant proportion of emergency department (ED) visits, but current diagnostic protocols often lead to overuse of computed tomography (CT) imaging, despite low diagnostic yield. The BRAIN-CT trial evaluates the impact of rapid access to TBI biomarkers on decision-making for cranial imaging in patients with mTBI.

pmc-13380563.title: Attenuated aortic–cerebral pulsatile transmission with posture-related increases in stroke volume in healthy young adults
pmc-13380563.creator: Rintaro Sakamoto, Yuka Ninomiya, Marina Fukuie, Koki Takahashi, Jun Sugawara
pmc-13380563.description: Excessive pulsatile hemodynamics increased under higher stroke volume (SV) impose mechanical stress on the cerebrovasculature, requiring attenuation before reaching the brain. SV is greater in the supine than upright, yet the characteristics of aortic-to-cerebral pulsatile transmission under such conditions are unclear.

pmc-13392128.title: Sphingosine kinase-2 inhibition promotes immunogenic differentiation of myeloid-derived suppressor cells through an Acetyl-CoA carboxylase-phosphatidylcholine axis
pmc-13392128.creator: Paramita Chakraborty, Shilpak Chatterjee, Mohamed Faisal Kassir, Wyatt Wofford, Seungho Choi, Natalia Oleinik, Ozge Saatci, Odai Darawshi, Satyajit Das, Nathaniel Oberhoeltzer, Anupam Gautam, Stephanie Mills, Reid DeMass, Zacharia Hedley, Yueying Liu, Rasesh Y Parikh, Sandip Paul, Souvik Seal, Charl
pmc-13392128.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Myeloid-derived suppressor cells (MDSCs) in the tumor microenvironment (TME) limit the efficacy of adoptive T cell therapies, highlighting the need to overcome tumor-associated immunosuppression. Sphingosine-1-phosphate (S1P), is an abundant signaling lipid in the TME. Here, we show that inhibition of sphingosine kinase-2 (SphK2), the enzyme generating S1P in MDSCs, reduces the suppressive activity of monocytic MDSCs (M-MDSCs) while promoting their differentiation toward a mature, immunogenic phenotype characterized by enhanced antigen presentation.

uslaw-usc-t54-s312101.title: 54 U.S.C. § 312101 — Definitions
uslaw-usc-t54-s312101.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t54-s312101.description: United States Code, Title 54 (National Park Service And Related Programs); Chapter 3121 (National Trust For Historic Preservation In The United States). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. In this chapter: (1) Board.— The term “Board” means the board of trustees of the National Trust. (2) National trust.— The term “National Trust” means the National Trust for Historic Preservation in the United States.
